OpenAI Seeks at Least $30 Billion at $1.4 Trillion Pre-Money Valuation

Bloomberg reported that OpenAI is seeking at least $30 billion in new funding at a pre-money valuation of about $1.4 trillion. The talks remain at an early stage and terms could change. The round is intended as bridge financing after OpenAI postponed its IPO plans. The company has confidentially filed to go public, but CEO Sam Altman said it will not pursue an IPO this year. MistTrack: Bitget Exploiter Attempted to Route Stolen Funds via Chainflip but Broker Rejected

According to on-chain monitoring by SlowMist's tracking arm MistTrack, the Bitget exploiter attempted to move stolen funds through the cross-chain liquidity protocol Chainflip, but the transaction was rejected at the broker interface ("deposit rejected by the broker"). The protocol did not freeze the capital but instead refunded the deposit directly back to the sender, effectively preventing the attacker from routing the exploit proceeds through the network.

SlowMist Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) 23pds stated that Apple has released a critical security update, which likely patches a zero-day vulnerability actively exploited to drain cryptocurrency wallets. Apple acknowledged a report indicating that the issue may have been exploited in extremely sophisticated attacks against specific targeted individuals, affecting iOS versions prior to iOS 27. — link

Coinbase Receives CFTC Approval for Derivatives Clearinghouse

Coinbase said the CFTC approved Coinbase Clearing LLC as a registered Derivatives Clearing Organization (DCO), completing its CFTC-regulated derivatives stack alongside its FCM and DCM. The clearinghouse will support USDC collateral and 24/7 settlement, allowing Coinbase to directly create and settle fully collateralized contracts. — link

NEAR Intents Blocks Over $50M in Bitget Hack Flows and Waives Recovery Bounty Share

Aurora co-founder Alex Shevchenko said attackers behind the September 24 Bitget hack attempted to move more than $50 million in stolen funds through NEAR Intents. Its SHIELD risk system detected the flows, with about $166,000 passing through and roughly $503,000 frozen mid-execution pending legal and recovery procedures. Shevchenko said about $387.5 million was stolen in total, with most cross-chain funds ultimately consolidated into ETH on Ethereum.

Users seeking restaking exposure must opt into a separate product built on Symbiotic.
